name: acs-portal-backend
description: ACS Chennai Employee Portal Backend API

scripts._comment_db_recover: [DR-032] Operator-triggered migration-ledger recovery. Default (no flag) is read-only inspection; pass --confirmed-abandoned after inspecting partial DDL and verifying backup readiness to actually delete rows. No longer wired into postinstall — install is database-free.
scripts._comment_no_postinstall: [DR-032] postinstall hook removed. Dependency installation must be DB-free — recovery is an explicit operator step (`npm run db:recover -- --confirmed-abandoned`), not something that fires automatically during `npm install`.
scripts.db:check: node -e "const {PrismaClient}=require('@prisma/client');const p=new PrismaClient();(async()=>{try{const KNOWN_BAD=['20260905020000_n17_projects','20260906000000_n1_project_fk','20260908150000_dr031_leave_constraint_correct_bound'];const nameList=KNOWN_BAD.map(n=>\"'\"+n.replace(/'/g,\"''\")+\"'\").join(',');const rows=await p.\$queryRawUnsafe('SELECT migration_name, finished_at, rolled_back_at, applied_steps_count FROM \"_prisma_migrations\" WHERE migration_name IN ('+nameList+')');let bad=0;for(const r of rows){const nonApplied=r.rolled_back_at===null&&(r.finished_at===null||r.applied_steps_count===0);if(nonApplied){bad+=1;console.error('NON-APPLIED:',r.migration_name);}}console.log('checked',rows.length,'allowlisted rows;',bad,'non-applied');if(bad>0)process.exit(1);}catch(e){console.error('db:check error:',e&&e.message);process.exit(2);}finally{await p.\$disconnect();}})();"
scripts._comment_db_check: [DR-032] Read-only migration ledger check used by CI and start.sh. Exits non-zero when allowlisted rows are clearly NOT applied (rolled_back_at IS NULL AND (finished_at IS NULL OR applied_steps_count = 0)). Use `npm run db:recover -- --confirmed-abandoned` to clear after human inspection. [DR-031-SQLFIX 2026-09-10] Added 20260908150000_dr031_leave_constraint_correct_bound to the allowlist so the inspection step accounts for the bootstrap recovery in start.sh.
